hook: LinkedIn serves thirty million ML features a second.

beats.say: LinkedIn built Venice, an open-source distributed platform, to separate data production from online consumption, with batch and streaming ingestion.
Imagine a recommendation platform making one hundred thousand predictions a second, each needing three hundred feature values, which adds up to thirty million values a second.
Venice gives low-latency access to materialized information, so serving machine learning data becomes an infrastructure problem as big as training.
